subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 9th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: 9th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: After about ten minutes

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 10th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: 10th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 1st day of the 3rd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: 1st day of the 3rd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: nilhogg's nose effect
fact: The Nilhogg's nose mushroom enhances smell sensitivity and amplifies perception of both good and bad odors.
source_quote: You can eat it, but it won’t fill you up. But after eating it, you can smell better and find good mushrooms and other smells. It’s like the smells become so much more. But if you smell a bad smell, it hurts you a lot more.

subject: tinmmasks spore effect
fact: Tinmmasks mushrooms release a 15-ft radius cloud of spores that induce poisoning and confusion effects when damaged.
source_quote: If it is heavily damaged or killed by uprooting, it spews a cloud of spores out to a radius of 15 ft. All those within the cloud may be poisoned for about a minute and, when poisoned, are affected by the same effects of a confusion spell.

subject: travel to Blingdenstone
fact: Blingdenstone is the best chance of escape from the Underdark.
source_quote: the best chance of escape is through the town of Blingdenstone

subject: Gracklstugh route
fact: Gracklstugh is a suggested destination for purchasing equipment before proceeding to Blingdenstone.
source_quote: Buppido insists on going to Gracklstugh first and suggests they can purchase the equipment they need to make it to Blingdenstone.

subject: water bladders value
fact: Water bladders are the most important adventuring gear found on the bandit corpses.
source_quote: the most important of which are water bladders

subject: tinderbox value
fact: The tinderbox is prized by Jimjar for toasting Ripplebark.
source_quote: Jimjar, however, is excited about the tinderbox - “Toasted Ripplebark, the best thing in the Underdark.”

subject: bet on Thorin's climb
fact: A bet is made that Thorin will make it across the gorge, with the outcome declared as 'Makes it.'
source_quote: “Makes it.”

subject: bet on monsters in tomb
fact: A bet is made that monsters will be found in the tomb, with the monster type specified as 'Skeletons and Zombies.'
source_quote:
“Skeletons and Zombies?”
“I’ll take that bet.”

subject: bandit attack detail
fact: The attackers are desperate bandits dressed in mixed armor and clothing, armed with scimitars and crossbows, and have been in the Underdark for some time.
source_quote: The attackers appear to be desperate bandits dressed in a mix of armor and clothing and armed with scimitars and crossbows. Their equipment suggests they have been in the Underdark for some time.

subject: bottomless gorge
fact: The group drops the bandit corpses into a bottomless gorge to avoid leaving a trail.
source_quote: And so the bodies are dropped into the bottomless gorge.

subject: Yuk Yuk's murder
fact: Yuk Yuk is found dead with his throat cut by a shortsword, which any member of the group could have wielded.
source_quote:
the corpse of Yuk Yuk, his throat cut with a blade.
Grygum examines the cut and notes, “It’s a shortsword. Any one of us could have done it.”

subject: bandit truce deception
fact: A group of bandits offers a truce with fabricated information about escaping the Underdark, claiming they got lost in a dungeon.
source_quote: We were exploring a dungeon and made one too many wrong turns, ending up deeper into the ground than we wanted to.

subject: Darklake route
fact: Traveling along the Darklake is considered less treacherous than traveling through tunnels.
source_quote: Sethir observes that traveling along the Darklake is less treacherous than traveling in tunnels.

subject: waterorbs yield
fact: Waterorbs yield about a gallon (almost four liters) of potable water when squeezed and wrung out.
source_quote: When mature, it was bulbous in shape and bigger than a human head. If squeezed and wrung out, it yields about a gallon (almost four liters) of potable water.

subject: Silken Tunnels
fact: The Silken Tunnels are behind the group as they enter the dark depths of the Underdark.
source_quote: The Silken Tunnels are behind them now, and the dark depths of the Underdark are ahead.

subject: Faerzress magic zone
fact: The tunnels and caves are rich in the eerie magic of the Faerzress.
source_quote: This part of the journey takes you through tunnels and caves rich in the Faerzress's eerie magic.

subject: Thorin's breakdown
fact: Thorin suddenly loses control, screaming, laughing, and weeping, before recovering and claiming he is fine.
source_quote:
But it is Thorin who suddenly loses it abruptly. He starts screaming, laughing, and weeping. ... He recovers.
“I have no idea what happened. But I am fine now.”

subject: Shuushar's awakening
fact: Shuushar the Awakened remarks that the archpriest Ploopploopeen in Sloobludop may help with madness.
source_quote: Shuushar the Awakened sees Thorin’s bout of madness and remarks that perhaps in Sloobludop, the archpriest Ploopploopeen can help.

subject: Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is a location where the archpriest Ploopploopeen, a follower of the Sea Mother, resides.
source_quote: Ploopploopeen is a follower of the Sea Mother, and she will be most welcoming of my awakening to the end of our people’s madness.

subject: Blingdenstone
fact: Blingdenstone is identified as the best escape route from the Underdark.
source_quote: the best chance of escape is through the town of Blingdenstone

subject: ripplebark properties
fact: Ripplebark is edible raw, improves in flavor when roasted, and can neutralize disease germs.
source_quote: They find some Ripplebark that, despite its rotten fresh appearance, is entirely edible in its raw state and could be roasted to improve its nutty flavor. Scorched or burnt ripplebark turned black but was still edible. It could also neutralize disease germs.

subject: Eldeth's frustration
fact: Eldeth is frustrated by trudging through the dark but remains an indispensable forager.
source_quote:
Her frustration at trudging through the dark will not stop her from finding plenty of food.
Her success as a forager has made her indispensable to the group.

subject: Thorin's relationship with giants
fact: Eldeth finds Thorin’s relationship with giants offputting due to the lingering effects of the War of the Giants.
source_quote: But the shield dwarf finds Thorin’s relationship with giants to be offputting. The War of the Giants that happened after the War of the Dragons ended in a peculiar stalemate.

subject: Grygum's skepticism
fact: Grygum is skeptical of Shuushar’s claim that 'Ploopploopeen' is a simple name to say.
source_quote: Grygum raises an eyebrow and is about to speak, but the tunnels turn left, and he finds himself in a massive cavern with what appears to be a bottomless gorge.

subject: Buppido's conviction
fact: Buppido is emphatic that leaving corpses creates a trail, and Zalthir believes him due to his Derro conviction.
source_quote:
Buppido is emphatic that this will leave a trail.
For some reason, Zalthir believes Buppido. There is something about the Derro’s conviction.

subject: cave with Tinmmasks
fact: A cave is covered with clusters of squat toadstools called Tinmmasks, each cluster containing no more than four mushrooms.
source_quote:
She is standing in front of a cave covered with mushrooms. She shouts, “Tinmmasks.”
Everyone looks closer and sees a field of squat toadstools growing to about two feet in width and height. They are grouped in clusters, with no more than four in a cluster.

subject: bandit corpse identification
fact: The corpse looted is identified as the bandit who escaped from the ambush near the gorge.
source_quote: they realize he is the bandit who escaped from the ambush near the gorge.

subject: Zalthir's question about corpse disposal
fact: Zalthir asks whether leaving bodies will impede pursuers or create a trail, triggering a debate.
source_quote: Zalthir turns to the locals, “Do we leave the bodies here, and will the ecosystem of monsters impede our pursuers? Or should we dispose of the bodies because it will be a trail?”

subject: Stool's mushroom discovery
fact: Stool identifies a mushroom as a Nilhogg's nose and describes its sensory-enhancing properties.
source_quote: Stool shouts, “That’s a cool mushroom!” He calls the mushroom a Nilhogg's nose. The young Myconid explains, “You can eat it, but it won’t fill you up. But after eating it, you can smell better and find good mushrooms and other smells. It’s like the smells become so much more. But if you smell a bad smell, it hurts you a lot more.”

subject: Jimjar's bet on monster type
fact: Jimjar dismisses 'Undead' as boring and accepts a bet on 'Skeletons and Zombies' in the tomb.
source_quote:
“Undead?”
“Boring.”
“Skeletons and Zombies?”
“I’ll take that bet.”

subject: Eldeth's track-hiding skill
fact: Eldeth’s ability to hide their tracks may be why the group is still alive.
source_quote: Her ability to hide their tracks may be why they are still alive.

subject: Thorin's climb and rope use
fact: Thorin ties a rope around his waist and climbs to the cavern roof to cross the gorge.
source_quote: He takes a rope, ties it around his waist, and then begins the hazardous sport of climbing to the roof of the cavern and then the gorge. He drops down as he gets to the other side of the gorge.

subject: Thorin's claim about debt
fact: Thorin shouts that they don't owe Jimjar any more money after his climb.
source_quote: Thorin shouts, “We don’t owe you any more money, Jimjar.”

subject: bandit truce offer
fact: A group of bandits offers information about escaping the Underdark in exchange for food.
source_quote: A group of bandits arrive under the flag of truce, offering information about how to get out of the Underdark.

subject: Underdark
fact: The Underdark is the primary environment where the group travels, filled with danger, magic, and ecological complexity.
source_quote: the dark depths of the Underdark are ahead
